removeWhen: When a published @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent release provides projectDir (or a reviewed equivalent the Gateway adopts), keeps transcript-held extension prompt sections in the idle session.systemPrompt (#1312), and ends a run start whose preflightResult("started") callback throws without leaving the session busy (#1340), serializes ModelRuntime config reads so readiness cannot overtake a detached registration refresh (#2199), preserves explicitly requested pending tool names when a host narrows the restored loadout before MCP registration (#2181), bundles undici 8.12.4 or later in both child entry points (#2470), and prevents the read cancellation-window crash fixed upstream by https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/12025 (#2529), lets a host supply its system-prompt preamble, order global context and skills before project sections, render the skills, docs and MCP servers sections and defer prompt sections of tools enabled mid-run to the next run (context 3.1-3.4), resolves direct-argv MCP credential references and provider apiKey credential references (#2593) and backs up global settings unset with reload at the write-queue boundary (#2535), exports a bounded config-only loadMcpConfig (#2553), and joins registration-triggered refreshes in settleCredentialWrites (#2534), remove the patch as the Gateway README section 'Tron-patched pi-coding-agent' lists, then npm run update:pi-sdk to that release.
